title: Import a CSV row into the inventory store
task: Add `ImportRow(row string, store Store) error` to package `inventory`. A row is `sku,name,quantity` as in `A100,Blue Widget,12`. Reject rows with the wrong number of fields, an empty SKU, or a quantity that is not a non-negative integer, and only put valid items into the store. Use the types already in the package; do not introduce a second item type. Add tests covering a valid row and each kind of rejection.
